name: item_id
description: Unique item key
why: Unique key for an item. Everything joins on it.

name: lot_id
description: Truckload / lot key
why: Key for a purchased batch. Items in one lot share price, source and condition mix, so cross-validation never splits a lot.

name: category
description: Product category
why: Biggest driver of recovery and of how fast something sells. Also the level at which markdown rules and minimum-value rules are set.

name: brand_tier
description: Premium / mid / generic brand tier
why: Premium brands hold value and match to the catalog more reliably than generic ones.

name: condition
description: Graded condition after testing
why: Tested condition after the warehouse grades it. Strongly shifts both the chance of a sale and the price.

name: retail_value
description: Recorded retail value from the catalog match (denominator of recovery rate)
why: The denominator of the recovery rate and the best single size signal. Also decides whether extra handling or photos can pay for themselves.

name: log_retail_value
description: Log of recorded retail value
why: Log of retail value: lets the model treat a $20 and a $2,000 item proportionally.

name: match_confidence
description: Confidence of the Amazon/Walmart catalog match
why: How sure the catalog match is. A wrong match corrupts the target, so low confidence widens uncertainty.

name: product_age_years
description: Years since the product model was released
why: Older models depreciate: recovery falls with age, differently by category.

name: title
description: Product title (text features)
why: Free text the staff type. Reduced to 8 numeric components so wording (model line, bundle, 'for parts') can inform the price.

name: matched_title
description: Title of the catalog entry matched to the item
why: The catalog entry the item was matched to. Used only by the match-quality model to compare against the listing title.

name: return_reason
description: Reason code from the original return
why: Why it came back. Defective returns recover less. Marked 'ask': confirm with the business that it is captured at receipt.

name: weight_class
description: 0 tiny .. 4 bulky; drives shipping and holding cost
why: 0 tiny to 4 bulky. Drives shipping and storage cost and sets how heavy holding is.

name: photo_count
description: Number of listing photos
why: Listing photos. Tested with a randomized experiment, not just observed, because staff photograph valuable items more.

name: receipt_to_listing_days
description: Days between receiving the item and listing it
why: Days sitting in the warehouse before listing. Slow listing hurts timing and ties up cash.

name: start_bid_pct
description: Opening bid as a share of retail value
why: Opening bid as a share of retail value. Sets the floor and affects the chance of zero bids.

name: auction_duration_days
description: Scheduled auction length
why: Auction length. Changes how many bidders see the item.

name: end_dow
description: Day of week the auction ends (0=Mon)
why: Day of week the auction ends. Weekend endings pull more bidders.

name: end_hour
description: Hour the auction ends
why: Hour the auction ends.

name: simultaneous_listings
description: Items of the same category listed in the same week (supply glut)
why: Items of the same category listed in the same week. A supply glut lowers prices.

name: listing_moy
description: Calendar month of listing (seasonality)
why: Month of year: seasonality. Also a drift alarm, because it changes every year.

name: listing_dow
description: Day of week of listing
why: Day of week listed.

name: source_id
description: Where the lot was bought
why: Which supplier. Sources differ in quality; used by the scorecard and, with care, by the models.

name: source_type
description: Type of source (big-box returns, closeout, broker, ...)
why: Big-box returns, e-commerce returns, overstock, broker liquidation, regional marketplace. The group-level view of quality.

name: region
description: Sourcing region (new regions appear with the national expansion)
why: Where the source sits. Affects freight and, after expansion, demand.

name: manifest_flag
description: Lot arrived with an itemized manifest
why: Whether the lot came with an item list. Blind lots are riskier and priced differently.

name: acquisition_rate
description: Lot price divided by lot retail value
why: Lot price divided by lot retail value: what we paid per retail dollar. Known at receipt, so it may feed prediction.

name: lot_item_count
description: Items in the lot
why: Items in the lot, for lot-level modelling.

name: pilot_arm
description: Randomized channel arm: fixed / auction / not_eligible
why: Which arm of the randomized fixed-price pilot the item was in (fixed-price or auction control). Context for the uplift analysis only.

name: premium_pct
description: Randomized premium over the expected auction price
why: Premium over expected auction price for fixed-price items (10/20/30%), randomized. Identifies price response.

name: photo_arm
description: Randomized extra-photo arm: none / control / extra
why: Which arm of the photo experiment (extra photos or control). Randomized, so the effect is causal.

name: handling_minutes
description: Warehouse minutes spent on the item
why: Warehouse labor minutes per item. Valued at the labor cost per minute. A cost, never an input to a prediction.

name: fees
description: Payment and marketplace fees
why: Marketplace fees. A cost and a sale-time quantity: not usable for prediction.

name: shipping_cost
description: Shipping subsidy (plus return shipping on refunds)
why: Outbound shipping. A cost known only after the sale.

name: holding_days
description: Days the item occupied the warehouse
why: Days the item occupied shelf space until it closed. Drives holding and capital cost. Known only after the sale.

name: bidders
description: Number of bidders (known only after the auction)
why: Number of bidders. An outcome of the auction: never a predictor.

name: watchers
description: Watchers while listed (time-varying; excluded from listing-time models)
why: People watching during the listing. Known too late to price the item.

name: sale_price
description: Price paid by the buyer
why: What the item sold for. The numerator of recovery. The target, so it can never be an input.

name: sold
description: Item sold
why: Whether it sold. Zero outcomes are final for auctions.

name: refund_flag
description: Sale was refunded
why: Whether a sold item was refunded. Known after the sale.
